description: This file contains a PHP class Api within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.User. It defines a controller for managing user API operations in the OpenCart admin panel, including methods for listing, viewing, adding, editing, and deleting API credentials, as well as handling API sessions and IP whitelists.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for managing user API credentials, sessions, and related data in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of APIs and initial setup.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the API list page with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the list of API entries based on filter and sort parameters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Displays a paginated list of APIs with sorting and filtering options.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the API form for creating or editing an API entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the save operation for API data (adding or editing).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected API entries.
